Bunny Legs.description:
Bunny Legs

Before Interposing or after Defending (after damage), hop up to your Speed in any direction for free, 1/encounter.
Bunny Legs.name: Bunny Legs

Chaotic Surge.description:
Chaotic Surge

Whenever you or a willing ally within Reach 6 casts a tiered spell, you may allow them to roll on the Chaos Table. 1/encounter.
Chaotic Surge.name: Chaotic Surge

Charge.description:
Charge

When you move at least 4 spaces, you can push a creature in your path. Medium: 1 space; Small/Tiny: up to 2 spaces. 1/turn.
Charge.name: Charge

Danger Pollen/Spores.description:
Danger Pollen/Spores

Whenever an enemy causes you one or more Wounds, you excrete soporific spores: all adjacent enemies are Dazed.
Danger Pollen/Spores.name: Danger Pollen/Spores

Draconic Heritage.description:
Draconic Heritage

+1 Armor. [A]

When you attack: deal an additional LVL+KEY damage (ignoring armor) divided as you choose among any of your targets; recharges whenever you Safe Rest or gain a Wound.
Draconic Heritage.name: Draconic Heritage

Elusive.description:
Elusive

+1 to Stealth [A]

If you fail a save, you can succeed instead, 1/Safe Rest
Elusive.name: Elusive

Flameborn.description:
Flameborn

1 of your neutral saves is advantaged instead. [M]
Flameborn.name: Flameborn

Hollow Bones.description:
Hollow Bones

You have a fly Speed as long as you are wearing armor no heavier than Leather.

Crits against you are Vicious (the attacker rolls 1 additional die).

Forced movement moves you twice as far.
Hollow Bones.name: Hollow Bones

New Place, New Face.description:
New Place, New Face

+2 shifting skill points. You may take on the appearance of any ancestry. When you do, you may place your 2 shifting skill points into any 1 skill. 1/day.
New Place, New Face.name: New Place, New Face

Odd Constitution.description:
Odd Constitution

Increment your Hit Dice one step (d6 » d8 » d10 » d12 » d20); they always heal you for the maximum amount. Magical healing always heals you for the minimum amount.
Odd Constitution.name: Odd Constitution

Optimistic.description:
Optimistic

Allow an ally within Reach 6 to reroll any single die. Resets when healed to your max HP.

-1 Speed [M]
Optimistic.name: Optimistic

Planeshift.description:
Planeshift

Whenever you Defend, you can gain 1 Wound to temporarily phase out of the material plane and ignore the damage.

–2 max Wounds. [A]
Planeshift.name: Planeshift

Reflective Aura.description:
Reflective Aura

When you Defend, gain KEY armor and deal KEY damage back to the attacker. 1/encounter.
Reflective Aura.name: Reflective Aura

Relentless.description:
Relentless

When you would drop to 0 HP, you may set your HP to LVL instead, 1/Safe Rest.

+1 Might. [A]
Relentless.name: Relentless

Scurry.description:
Scurry

Gain +2 armor if you moved on your last turn. [M]
Scurry.name: Scurry

Skedaddle.description:
Skedaddle

Can move 2 spaces for free after you become the target of an attack or negative effect (after damage, ignoring difficult terrain).
Skedaddle.name: Skedaddle

Small But Ferocious.description:
Small But Ferocious

Whenever you make a single-target attack against a creature larger than you, roll 1 additional d6 for each size category it is larger. They do the same.
Small But Ferocious.name: Small But Ferocious

Stout.description:
Stout

+2 max Hit Dice [M]

+1 max Wounds [A]

-1 Speed [M]
Stout.name: Stout

Strength of Stone.description:
Strength of Stone

Force an enemy to reroll a crit against you, 1/encounter.

+2 Might. [A]
Strength of Stone.name: Strength of Stone

Wily.description:
Wily

Force an enemy to reroll a non-critical attack against you, 1/encounter.

+3 to Influence friendly characters. [M]

Advantage on skill checks related to dragons. [M]
Wily.name: Wily
